short_description: Penta was a Berlin-based digital business banking provider for German small and medium-sized enterprises, freelancers and the self-employed, founded in 2016 and launched in Germany in 2017. It was acquired by the French SME finance platform Qonto in 2022; its customers were migrated to the Qonto platform and the Penta brand was retired, so Penta no longer operates as an independent company.
